docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:1:# VelaWear 从蜂鸣声升级为佩戴端 AI 女声：资料研究
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:4:范围：只做资料和当前工程核对，不修改固件源码、不烧录、不宣称完成现场听感验证。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:8:当前蜂鸣声不是“把频率转换成人声”的问题，而是需要增加一条语音数据链路：
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:12:  -> 主机 BLE 桥接器
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:13:  -> 云端 TTS
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:14:  -> 16 kHz、单声道、16-bit PCM
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:15:  -> BLE GATT 应用层分片
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:18:  -> PA42/功放/扬声器
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:21:最小可行版本建议：主机保存 API key，调用 OpenAI 兼容的 TTS HTTP API；要求返回原始 PCM，主机侧重采样到 16 kHz 单声道；板端一次缓存并播放最多约 2 秒语音。BLE 不传一个“长属性”，而是新建音频写入特征，按当前连接的 `ATT_MTU - 3` 动态分片，并用应用层序号、总长度和 CRC 做完整性校验。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:23:“AI 女朋友”的亲密、温柔语气主要由 TTS 的 voice/instructions 和上游对话提示词决定。它不能由当前板端的 `g_tone[]` 方波表产生。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:25:## 1. TTS API 与音频格式
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:44:上面的 voice 和 instructions 是方案示例，不是对“女声”或中文效果的现场保证。官方列出了内置 voices，并推荐 `marin` 或 `cedar` 获得较好质量；官方同时说明这些 voice 当前主要针对英语优化。中文在支持语言列表中，但需要在板端/实际扬声器上确认自然度。[Voice 与语言说明](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech#voice-options)
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:46:OpenAI 官方还要求向终端用户清晰披露听到的是 AI 生成的声音而非真人声音。产品界面或说明中应保留该披露。[官方 TTS 文档中的披露要求](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech#text-to-speech)
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:52:因此，第一版不建议把 MP3/Opus 解码器放进 SF32LB52 固件。主机桥接器收到 PCM 后，在发送前重采样为板端确定支持的格式，例如 16 kHz、单声道、16-bit little-endian。这样板端只做协议校验、缓冲和 DMA 播放。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:54:官方 TTS API 支持 chunk transfer streaming，可以在完整文件生成前收到音频数据。[OpenAI streaming audio 说明](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech#streaming-realtime-audio)
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:56:不过，本项目第一版不必立即做“边生成边播放”。先采用“生成一段短语、校验完整、再播放”的方式，协议和故障边界更简单；确认带宽和缓冲后再改为流水式播放。

docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:70:## 2. BLE GATT 长数据、MTU 与分片
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:72:### 2.1 一次 GATT 包能传多少
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:76:当前 VM 构建配置中可以直接看到：
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:90:`CONFIG_BT_L2CAP_TX_MTU=253` 是当前构建支持的上限配置，不等于每次连接的运行时 ATT_MTU 已经是 253。实现时必须在连接上通过栈的 MTU 查询接口获得实际值，再按 `bt_gatt_get_mtu(conn) - 3` 计算单片上限。Zephyr 官方 GATT API 提供 `bt_gatt_get_mtu()`、`bt_gatt_notify()`、`bt_gatt_notify_cb()` 等接口；当前项目使用的头文件和 API 命名空间也是 `zephyr/bluetooth/gatt.h`。[Zephyr 官方 GATT Server API](https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/doxygen/html/group__bt__gatt__server.html)
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:96:一段 1～2 秒 PCM 是数万字节，不适合使用 GATT long write 作为单次事务。应将“语音流”定义为多个独立的应用层 frame：每片携带 stream id、chunk sequence/offset、payload length，并在开始/结束帧中传输格式、总长度和校验信息。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:100:ATT 规范明确指出，notification 和 command 没有 ATT 层响应或流控；在未增强 ATT bearer 上，因接收缓冲溢出而无法处理的 notification 可能被丢弃，command 也应视为不可靠。[Bluetooth Core 6.1, ATT sequential protocol](https://www.bluetooth.com/wp-content/uploads/Files/Specification/HTML/Core-61/out/en/host/attribute-protocol--att-.html)
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:106:| `AUDIO_START` | 主机写入 | stream id、总字节数、采样率、声道数、位深、CRC32 |
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:107:| `AUDIO_DATA` | 主机写入 | stream id、序号/offset、音频 payload |
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:108:| `AUDIO_END` | 主机写入 | 声明传输结束，板端比较实际长度和 CRC |
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:111:具体传输可使用“Write Without Response + 小窗口 + ACK notification”。如果首版优先保证可靠而不是吞吐，则每片使用 Write Request，收到响应后再发送下一片；这会更慢但更容易定位丢包。不要复用当前只承载短命令的 Agent command 或 LLM response 特征。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:113:Bluetooth Core GATT 规范定义了 Write Characteristic Value、Write Without Response、Write Long Characteristic Value 和 Notification 等不同子程序，并要求写长值时使用 Prepare/Execute 过程。[Bluetooth Core 6.1, Part G GATT write procedures](https://www.bluetooth.com/wp-content/uploads/Files/Specification/HTML/Core-61/out/en/host/generic-attribute-profile--gatt-.html)

docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:180:| 音频格式 | 数据率 | 1 秒 | 2 秒 | 在 240-byte 应用 payload 下的片数 |
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:183:| 建议首版：16 kHz | 32,000 B/s | 32,000 B | 64,000 B | 134 / 267 |
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:186:计算依据：`采样率 × 2 bytes × 秒数`；片数为向上取整的 `ceil(字节数 / 240)`。240 字节是假设运行时 ATT_MTU 为 253 且预留约 10 字节应用层 header 的工程估算；实际实现应使用 `max(1, bt_gatt_get_mtu(conn) - 3 - header_size)`。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:188:按当前驱动“每个样本占一个 32-bit DMA word”的方式，16 kHz、16-bit 音频若直接放入现有 DAC buffer，1 秒约需 64 KB，2 秒约需 128 KB；8 kHz、2 秒约需 64 KB。这解释了为什么“2 秒、16 kHz、整段缓存后播放”是当前内存下较合适的第一版边界，但它会占用现有的大块音频 buffer，不能再无计划地叠加多个副本。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:190:实际吞吐还受连接间隔、控制器分片、主机栈、ATT_MTU 是否成功协商、ACK 窗口和重传影响。当前 `CONFIG_BT_BUF_ACL_TX_SIZE=27` 说明链路层 ACL buffer 仍可能把较大的 L2CAP/ATT 数据拆成多个链路包；不能仅凭 `CONFIG_BT_L2CAP_TX_MTU=253` 宣称 253-byte 单包空口发送。

docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:212:1. 在现有音频资源互斥锁下，先停止连续 MEMS 采集，再接收/播放语音；播放结束后恢复采集，并增加“同一进程恢复”的运行日志。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:214:3. 保留 mute-before-clock-settle 的顺序；PA42 只在确认硬件安全电平后打开，不能因为日志显示 DMA 完成就默认打开。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:221:- 16 kHz PCM 在当前 AUDCODEC 时钟配置下的真实音高、采样率和是否有削波/噪声。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:222:- PA42 的实际有效电平、外部功放供电、扬声器阻抗/连接，以及打开 PA 是否仍会复位。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:224:- BLE 在目标 Windows/手机主机上的运行时 ATT_MTU、可持续吞吐、丢片率和重传行为。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:225:- “2 秒整段缓存后播放”期间 SRAM 余量、音频 buffer 与 LVGL/IMU/BLE 任务的并发影响。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:226:- 中文内置 voice 的女声自然度；官方明确提示 voices 主要针对英语优化，不能把 API 支持中文等同于中文听感已达标。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:228:- 产品是否已在 LCD/APP 文案中披露“这是 AI 生成的声音”。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:230:## 7. 研究基线与当前实现状态
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:232:本文件记录的是 2026-08-26 实施前的技术研究基线。随后已在 VM 权威源码和主机桥中落地：
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:234:- 板端新增独立 `AUDIO_STREAM` GATT 写入特征，接收带 CRC 的 16 kHz/mono/16-bit PCM，并通过现有 AUDCODEC DAC DMA 播放。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:235:- 板端新增 `CHAT_INPUT` GATT 写入特征，收到 UTF-8 文本后进入既有 LLM 动作队列。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:236:- 主机桥新增情绪提示词、对话历史、TTS 请求、24 kHz 到 16 kHz 重采样，以及 `--prompt` 一次性聊天命令。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:237:- 主机桥新增 `--interactive` 持续聊天模式，保持单个 BLE 会话并将每轮“你/她”消息交给同一条 LLM/TTS 链路。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:238:- 主机桥发现逻辑支持固定地址、广播名和服务 UUID；新增 WinRT 只读探针用于区分 Windows 射频扫描故障与 GATT 协议故障。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:239:- LCD 应用中心新增“AI女友”入口，支持触摸快捷话题“陪我聊聊 / 给我鼓励 / 提醒休息”；云端不可用时由板端本地陪伴回复兜底。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:240:- Windows 主机新增 Tkinter “AI 陪伴”面板，保持单个 BLE 会话，提供聊天记录、快捷话题、连接状态和手表女声开关；`--demo` 可在无蓝牙时检查界面与中文字体。
docs/guides/velawear-voice-research.md:241:- 这版已完成 Ninja 编译、`sftool --verify` 烧录和启动日志验证；Windows 无线发现仍需现场/主机环境复测。

# Embedded Development Workflow

## 1. Core Principles

### P1: Code Serves Hardware
Code does not exist in isolation. Every line exists to control hardware.
Verify the hardware responds, not just that the code compiles.

### P2: Read Manual Before Code
Read the reference manual (RM0090) and HAL manual (UM1725) before writing code.
No manual found = do not guess. Download it or ask the user.

### P3: Verify Every 20 Lines
Do not write 400 lines then test. Write ~20 lines, compile, flash, verify.
If a step fails, stop immediately. Do not stack unverified changes.

### P4: Libraries Have Bugs
STM32 HAL has known bugs and undocumented behaviors. Check errata, check
community issues, check the project's debug logs before trusting a library call.

### P5: Hardware First, Software Second
When something does not work, read the register first. Check clock enable,
check pin mux, check GPIO mode. Only then suspect the software logic.

---

## 2. Development Standards

### S1: Small-Step MVP
Each iteration touches ~20 lines. One feature, one test, one commit.

### S2: Split Modules Proactively
Break large features into small, independently testable modules.
Each module gets its own verification step.

### S3: Limit AI Modification Scope
User specifies which files AI may modify. AI must not touch unspecified files.
If AI needs to modify additional files, it must ask first.

### S4: Protect Existing Functionality
Never break what already works. Run existing tests after each change.
If a change risks existing features, isolate it on a branch.

### S5: Scientific Error Response
On error: analyze cause first, then fix code. Do not blindly try random changes.
Read registers, check clock trees, verify pin configuration before modifying code.

### S6: Two-Strike Rollback Rule
- First failure: let AI attempt fix.
- Second failure: let AI try a different approach.
- Third failure: rollback to last known good state. Re-approach from fundamentals.

---

## 3. Workflow (10 Steps)

### Step 0: Read Documentation First
**Before starting any task, read the documentation first.**

```
1. Read CLAUDE.md → Understand project rules
2. Read docs/config/*.md → Understand constraints
3. Read docs/design/*.md → Understand architecture
4. Read docs/debug_logs/*.md → Understand known issues
5. Read docs/reports/*.md → Understand past reviews
```

**Why**: Documentation contains the collective knowledge of the project. Skipping documentation means repeating past mistakes.

### Step 1: Classify Task Type
Determine which flow to use:

| Task Type     | Flow     | Key Steps                              |
|---------------|----------|----------------------------------------|
| New Peripheral | Full     | Manual -> Configure -> Verify -> Integrate |
| Bug Fix        | Short    | Analyze -> Fix -> Verify               |
| Optimization   | Quick    | Modify -> Compile -> Done              |
| Refactor       | Safe     | Understand -> Modify -> Verify         |
| Testing        | test     | Design -> Write -> Run -> Analyze      |
| Documentation  | Doc      | Collect -> Write -> Review -> Publish  |
| Deployment     | Deploy   | Prepare -> Flash -> Verify -> Confirm  |

### Step 2: Read Reference Manual (RM0090) -- REQUIRED

**必须用工具读取，不能编造！**

**搜索方法（3 步）：**
```
Step 2.1: 用 TOC 查找章节页码（doc.get_toc()）
Step 2.2: 用关键词搜索精确定位（搜索 EXTSEL/SMP/MMS）
Step 2.3: 用 PyMuPDF 读取验证（对比 AI 输出）
```

**验收标准：**
- [ ] 找到 ADC 章节页码（Page 390）
- [ ] 找到 DMA 章节页码（Page 304）
- [ ] 找到 TIM 章节页码（Page 515）

- [ ] 用 PyMuPDF 验证内容匹配

### Step 3: Read HAL Library Manual (UM1725) -- REQUIRED

**搜索方法：** 同 Step 2

**验收标准：**

- [ ] 找到 HAL_TIM_Base_Start 页码

### Step 4: Read Project Documentation -- REQUIRED

**验证：必须输出具体页码和内容。没有证据 = 没有读手册。**

### Step 6.5: Pre-Code Checklist -- REQUIRED

**写外设代码前必须完成以下检查。不检查 = 不写代码。**

#### 定时器 (TIM)
- [ ] TRGO 公式: `TRGO = timer_clk / (PSC+1) / (ARR+1)`
- [ ] 反推 PSC: `PSC = timer_clk / (target_trgo * (ARR+1)) - 1` ← **必须考虑 ARR！**
- [ ] MasterOutputTrigger 设为什么？（默认 RESET 不输出）
- [ ] 运行时修改 PSC/ARR 后需要 EGR=UG

#### ADC
- [ ] ExternalTrigConv = TIMx_TRGO
- [ ] ContinuousConvMode = DISABLE（外部触发模式）
- [ ] DMAContinuousRequests = ENABLE（循环采集）
- [ ] 采样时间：高阻信号源用 480 cycles

#### DMA
- [ ] Direction: Peripheral → Memory 还是 Memory → Peripheral？
- [ ] Mode: Circular（循环采集）
- [ ] __HAL_LINKDMA 链接到外设

#### 启动顺序

### Step 9.5: Structured Debugging -- REQUIRED

**遇到问题时按此流程执行，不要随机尝试。**

#### 流程
```
1. 收集数据 → 串口输出、寄存器值
2. 分类问题 → 查表定位可能原因
3. 方波测试 → 最快验证 DAC/ADC 链路
4. 检查公式 → 定时器频率、采样率
5. 读寄存器 → PSC、ARR、CNT、DMA CR
6. 三次失败 → 停下来，回滚，人工介入
```

#### 方波测试（最快验证方法）
```c
// 临时替换波形生成函数
for (uint32_t i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    buffer[i] = (i < size/2) ? amplitude : 0;
}
```
- ADC min ≈ 116, max ≈ 2041 → DAC/ADC 链路正常
- 范围 < 100 → DAC 频率太低或未输出

#### 数据分析（不只看表面）
```python
# 检查 ADC 缓冲区范围
ranges = [max - min for min, max in zip(mins, maxs)]
avg_range = sum(ranges) / len(ranges)
if avg_range > 1000: print("频率正确")
elif avg_range > 100: print("频率偏低，检查PSC公式")
else: print("频率严重偏低或未输出")
```

**Why:** 12天项目中，花2小时排查波形问题，根因是TIM预分频公式错误。如果先分析ADC范围，5分钟就能发现。

## 5. Anti-Deception Mechanism

### Rule A1: AI Cannot Self-Claim Verification
AI must NOT say "I verified" or "it works." AI can only:
- Output code and expected values.
- Output verification code for the user to run.
- Output a checklist of what to check.

### Rule A2: User Confirms Critical Steps
At critical checkpoints, AI must wait for user confirmation:
- Before proceeding to next major step.
- After user runs verification code.
- Before committing changes.

If user says "confirmed" -> proceed.
If user says "wrong" -> rollback and re-analyze.

### Rule A3: Tool-Based Verification Required
Verification must use tools, not AI assertions:

| Tool           | What It Verifies                        |
|----------------|-----------------------------------------|
| Compiler       | 0 errors, 0 warnings                   |
| Static Analysis| cppcheck or equivalent                  |
| Serial Output  | Register values match expected          |
| Multimeter     | Pin voltage matches expected            |
| Oscilloscope   | Signal waveform matches expected        |
| Logic Analyzer | Timing and protocol correctness         |

### Rule A4: Output Verification Checklist
For every change, AI must output a checklist:
```
Verification Checklist:
[ ] Compile: 0 errors, 0 warnings
[ ] Register X value: expected 0xYYYY, actual ____
[ ] Pin PA0 voltage: expected ____V, actual ____V
[ ] Serial output: "OK" received: [ ] yes [ ] no
```

### Rule A5: Three-Strike Debug Rule
- Attempt 1: Analyze data, try targeted fix
- Attempt 2: Try different approach
- Attempt 3: STOP. Rollback code. Re-analyze from fundamentals.
- **Never try the same approach 3 times.**

### Rule A6: Data Analysis Before Conclusion
- Do NOT say "voltage is normal" without checking min/max range
- Do NOT say "waveform is correct" without checking ADC buffer range
- Always check: range > 1000 = correct, range < 100 = frequency too low

### Rule A7: Documentation After Fix
After every fix, automatically update:
1. `memory/` debug lessons
2. `docs/debug_logs/` log
3. `docs/INDEX.md`
- **Do NOT wait for user to remind you.**

# Verification Before Completion

## Overview

**Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.

**Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**

## The Iron Law

```
NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
```

If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.

## The Gate Function

```
BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:

1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
   - If NO: State actual status with evidence
   - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim

Skip any step = lying, not verifying
```

## Common Failures

| Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
|-------|----------|----------------|
| Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
| Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
| Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
| Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
| Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
| Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
| Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |

## Red Flags - STOP

- Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
- Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
- About to commit/push/PR without verification
- Trusting agent success reports
- Relying on partial verification
- Thinking "just this once"
- Tired and wanting work over
- **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**

## Rationalization Prevention

| Excuse | Reality |
|--------|---------|
| "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
| "I'm confident" | Confidence ≠ evidence |
| "Just this once" | No exceptions |
| "Linter passed" | Linter ≠ compiler |
| "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
| "I'm tired" | Exhaustion ≠ excuse |
| "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
| "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |

## Key Patterns

**Tests:**
```
✅ [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
❌ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
```

**Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
```
✅ Write → Run (pass) → Revert fix → Run (MUST FAIL) → Restore → Run (pass)
❌ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
```

**Build:**
```
✅ [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"
❌ "Linter passed" (linter doesn't check compilation)
```

**Requirements:**
```
✅ Re-read plan → Create checklist → Verify each → Report gaps or completion
❌ "Tests pass, phase complete"
```

**Agent delegation:**
```
✅ Agent reports success → Check VCS diff → Verify changes → Report actual state
❌ Trust agent report
```

## When To Apply

**ALWAYS before:**
- ANY variation of success/completion claims
- ANY expression of satisfaction
- ANY positive statement about work state
- Committing, PR creation, task completion
- Moving to next task
- Delegating to agents

**Rule applies to:**
- Exact phrases
- Paraphrases and synonyms
- Implications of success
- ANY communication suggesting completion/correctness

结论：当前不能称为 “AI girlfriend loop complete”。

软件路径已具备，但运行时闭环停在 Windows BLE 可见性/GATT；声音和触摸仍缺实物证据。`nuttx.bin@0x12010000`、1 Mbps、HCI `0x2006/08/09/0a → status 0x00` 只能证明板端控制器接受了广播配置，不能证明 Windows 能收到广播、GATT 可连接或扬声器有声。

审计范围：只检查当前 VelaWear 的源码/build、BLE/LLM、音频 HIL、串口快照和物理验收边界；没有编辑、烧录或打开板端串口。

已扫描：

- 本地文档、`tools/sf32lb52_audio_hil.py`、BLE 探针、LLM bridge 及测试。
- VM 权威源码、`.config`、`ninja -t commands`、构建产物和 flash manifest。
- 串口快照脚本、临时 BLE 日志和 VM 历史日志。
- 本地单测：`python -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py'`，21 tests，0 failures。
- 本地 Git 无提交且主要是编排/证据文件；VM 分支 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 有用户既有未提交修改。
- VM `logs/pjjuihj/manifest.json` 只更新到 2026-08-15，没有当前 8 月 25/26 日 UART HIL 原始日志。

| 层级/任务 | 状态 | 证据 | Blocking? | Action Required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VM 实际编译源与构建入口 | `Implemented` | `ninja -t commands` 指向实际 `contest2026_329_dela/app/velawear_agent`；构建日志结束于 `[32/32] Generating System.map`；当前产物 SHA-256 为 `dfae03ad...`。 | No | — |
| 当前板镜像与冷启动/HCI 证据绑定 | `Implemented but Untested` | 交接记录有 `SFBL → ABCD → NuttX/NSH` 和 advertising；本轮交接提供四个 HCI status `0x00`，但没有当前 UART 日志把板上运行镜像绑定到当前 SHA。 | No | 保存一次当前镜像 SHA、1 Mbps 冷启动和四条 HCI 回执的同一份日志。 |
| Windows 广播可见性、GATT 连接、command/result 回环 | `Blocked` | WinRT direct probe 在 `BluetoothLEDevice.from_bluetooth_address_async()` 返回 `device=none`；既有日志没有 `connected=true`、写入或 `0102341200` 结果帧。见 [sf32lb52_ble_direct_probe.py](C:/Users/CMJ/Documents/ChatGPT/openvela/tools/sf32lb52_ble_direct_probe.py:23)。 | **Yes** | 先用手机/第二个 BLE 扫描器观察 `VelaWear` 和服务 UUID；可见后再处理 Windows/VM，随后完成 GATT 回环。 |
| `CHAT_INPUT → LLM → TTS → AUDIO_STREAM → 板端播放` | `Partially Implemented` | VM 有 `CHAT_INPUT`、LLM、音频特征和播放处理；bridge 有有序 PCM 分片；21 个主机单测通过。缺少实际 GATT 连接和板端运行日志。 | **Yes** | GATT 恢复后用 `--once --prompt`、`VELAWEAR_TTS_ENABLED=1`，同时记录主机与 UART：`connected=true`、`cloud_response_ready`、`tts_audio_sent` 以及板端音频日志。 |
| 连续 MEMS 的暂停→播放→同进程恢复 | `Partially Implemented` | `audio_hw_test.c` 已有共享锁、停止/播放/恢复路径；历史 HIL 到达 `continuous MEMS capture stopped` 和 `AudioAlert begin`，随后发生重启，未证明同一进程恢复。 | **Yes** | 长 UART 窗口要求出现 `AudioVoice DMA complete`、`speaker voice played` 后再次 `continuous MEMS capture started`，且无新的 `SFBL`/Fault。 |
| 65 秒 HIL 触发当前 30 秒久坐提醒 | `Incorrectly Implemented` | [sf32lb52_audio_hil.py](C:/Users/CMJ/Documents/ChatGPT/openvela/tools/sf32lb52_audio_hil.py:4) 写死“30 秒提醒”；当前 VM `.config` 是 `CONFIG_VELAWEAR_SEDENTARY_THRESHOLD_SEC=3600`，且脚本不设置阈值。 | No | GATT 恢复后临时写入阈值 30 秒，或使用专门测试配置；直接 AI 聊天路径可绕过该等待。 |
| 真实扬声器播放 AI 女声 | `Blocked` | 当前源码 `VELAWEAR_ENABLE_EXTERNAL_PA=0`，voice 路径明确执行 `audio_pa_set(false)`：`.../drivers/audio_hw_test.c:38-41,768-774`。DMA 完成不是有声证明。 | **Yes** | 先检查 PA42、功放供电/负载和 mute 极性；确认安全后才启用 PA、重新构建/烧录，并用低音量已知 PCM 实测听感和复位稳定性。 |
| LCD/触摸 AI 女友入口及 120 秒稳定性 | `Deferred to Human` | 当前源码有第 9 项“AI女友”和三个快捷话题：`.../drivers/display_manager.c:45-48,257-284,447-457`；旧验收清单的实物触摸、KEY2、120 秒唤醒仍未勾选，见 [ui-app-center-test.md](C:/Users/CMJ/Documents/ChatGPT/openvela/ui-app-center-test.md:89)。 | No | 实物进入 AI 女友，触发至少一个快捷话题，确认屏幕文字、返回/KEY2 和 120 秒后仍可交互。 |
| HIL 自动判定闭环 | `Partially Implemented` | 音频 HIL 只输出原始串口并返回 SSH 状态，没有 marker 解析；其测试只有 CRLF/ASCII/脚本生成 3 项，见 [test_sf32lb52_audio_hil.py](C:/Users/CMJ/Documents/ChatGPT/openvela/tools/test_sf32lb52_audio_hil.py:6)。BLE regression 也只覆盖服务、状态、阈值、CCCD，见 [velawear_ble_regression.py](C:/Users/CMJ/Documents/ChatGPT/openvela/tools/velawear_ble_regression.py:63)。 | No | 增加一个严格的日志解析器/包装器，至少强制检查 GATT、TTS、音频播放和恢复 marker；否则只能人工判读。 |

Totals: 1 `Implemented`, 7 non-terminal, 1 terminal non-`Implemented`。本次按只读范围停止，没有执行 Phase 2 修改或烧录。

最小闭环集合：

1. 不改 BLE UUID、HCI 广播选项或 Classic/SMP/MbedTLS；先用第二台设备区分 RF/板端问题与 Windows/VM 问题。
2. GATT 恢复后，先跑现有 BLE regression，再跑一次真实 `CHAT_INPUT` → LLM → TTS → PCM stream。
3. AI 女友直聊不需要等待 30 秒；久坐提醒 HIL 才需要临时把阈值写为 30 秒。
4. 物理声音若确实经过外部功放，必须处理当前 PA42 禁用问题；这是当前最小的固件/硬件门槛。
5. 最终必须同时具备：主机 BLE/TTS 日志、板端 UART 音频日志、实际听到的中文女声、LCD/触摸观察和无复位长时结果。

当前不应把本地 fallback 文字、`advertising start ret=0`、HCI `status=0x00` 或 `DMA complete` 单独算作 AI 女友闭环完成。
